info.title: VNWatch Web Services API
info.description: VNWatch catalog, accounts, cart, orders, coupons, support, reviews and ADMIN management. Use the opaque sessionToken from POST /auth/login or /auth/admin/login in Authorize. Management requires an active ADMIN; CUSTOMER and STAFF retain account-owned shopping. Reference products include provenance; DEMO products and inventory are simulated. COD and QR are demo payment flows, no real funds transfer. Local reset outbox sends no external email. Money is integer VND; timestamps are UTC.
